subject: Re: Series A — Term Sheet Follow-Up
body:
Hi,

Great meeting last week. We've discussed internally and would like to move forward. Can you send over the updated cap table and latest MRR figures by Friday? We'd like to present to our Monday partners meeting.

Also, are you still targeting a $12M raise? Let's align on valuation expectations before we draft the term sheet.

Best,
Sarah Chen
Partner, Sequoia Capital

subject: Intro: CTO of DataFlow (portfolio co)
body:
Hey!

Wanted to connect you with Marcus Webb, CTO at DataFlow (one of our portfolio companies). They solved a similar infrastructure scaling challenge last year and Marcus offered to share their playbook.

subject: Due Diligence Request — Customer References
body:
Hi,

As part of our due diligence process, we'd need to speak with 3-4 of your enterprise customers. Could you share reference contacts by August 18th?

We're also looking for:
- Monthly cohort retention data (last 12 months)
- Current burn rate and runway
- Org chart with key hires planned

Looking forward to progressing this.

Best,
Lisa Morgan
Principal, Lightspeed

subject: Quarterly Catch-Up — How's Q3 Shaping Up?
body:
Hey!

It's been a few months since we last chatted. Would love to hear how Q3 is tracking — any big wins or challenges?

No rush, but if you're free next week for a 20-min call, I'd enjoy catching up. We've also been seeing some interesting M&A activity in your space that might be worth discussing.

Best,
James

subject: URGENT: Dashboard down for 2 hours — SLA breach
body:
Our entire analytics dashboard has been showing 502 errors since 7am this morning. This is now a 2-hour outage which puts us past the SLA threshold in our enterprise agreement.

We have a board presentation at 3pm TODAY that depends on this data. If this isn't resolved within the next hour, we need to escalate to your CEO directly and discuss SLA credits.

This is the third incident this quarter. We need a post-mortem and a concrete reliability plan.

— Mike Torres
VP Operations, BigClient Inc.

subject: Feature Request: Slack Integration
body:
Hi team,

Love the product! One thing that would make our workflow 10x better: a native Slack integration so we get alerts in our #ops channel instead of checking email.

A few of our team members have mentioned this independently. Would be a big retention driver for us.

Would love to know if this is on the roadmap.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Considering alternatives — need to talk
body:
Hey,

I'll be straight with you — we've been evaluating [Competitor X] and their new pricing is pretty aggressive. We're not ready to churn yet, but I wanted to flag this before our renewal comes up on September 1st.

Can we hop on a call this week to discuss? I think there's a path forward but I need to understand your product roadmap for Q4.

Best,
David Kim
CEO, TechStartup
